The '''Northern Jundland Wastes''' was the region of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] that lay north of [[the Wound]]. The [[Dreviad Wastes]], the [[Deathly Heat]], [[Manister Base]], and [[Camp Karnori]] were location in the area, and the [[Suns' Rise Ridge]] bordered the southern edge of the Wastes.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Northern Jundland Wastes was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The Northern Jundland Wastes did not appear formally in the planetary map of the Jundland Wastes<ref name="TOR" /> but was mentioned in the descriptions of several missions taking place in the northern part of the Jundland Wastes. These missions placed several locations in the Northern Jundland Wastes, namely the [[Ut'ttailri Jawa Camp]],<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" /> the [[Northern Jundland Plateau]],<ref name="TOR:SoF" /><ref name="TOR:RAD" /> the [[Shock Drum facility]],<ref name="TOR:TSD" /> [[Grommik's Residence]],<ref name="TOR:LOO" /> the [[Dreviad Outpost]],<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" /><ref name="TOR:DR" /> the [[Chuaro Farmstead]],<ref name="TOR:Goodwill" /> [[Manister Base]],<ref name="TOR:MT" /> [[Rinnas Edu's farmstead]],<ref name="TOR:NN" /> and [[Outpost Largona]].<ref name="TOR:MT" />It could therefore concluded that the regions known as the [[Deathly Heat]],<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" /><ref name="TOR:SoF" /><ref name="TOR:RAD" /><ref name="TOR:TSD" /><ref name="TOR:LOO" /> the [[Dreviad Wastes]],<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" /><ref name="TOR:DR" /><ref name="TOR:Goodwill" /> the [[Northern Wastes]],<ref name="TOR:MT" /><ref name="TOR:NN" /> and the [[Suns' Rise Ridge]]<ref name="TOR:MT" /> were located in the Northern Jundland Wastes, which correspond to most of the regions of the Jundland Wastes located north to [[the Wound]].<ref name="TOR" />
